summary: Confirmed the 2026-27 rates on the operator's page ($83 off-season base to $102 premium in season, 1-2 occupants). Added phone/email booking, 167 sites (~42x30 ft lots), free wifi. Note's rate sentences dropped as redundant with fees. Not stated: hookups, showers/laundry, max rig length, season (year-round implied, not stated).
flags: Long-stay check: the operator sells daily ($83-$102) and weekly rates to anyone ('Come for a day, a week, a month or a lifetime'; 'all age resort'), but the rate page is mostly 2-6 month snowbird rates and reservations are by phone/email only. Nights do look genuinely for sale; noting it for the five-test rule.
